title: Comparative genomics of zooxanthellate and azooxanthellate Palythoa (Cnidaria: Zoantharia) provides insights into symbiosis evolution and the origin of palytoxin
authors: Yoshioka, Y., Shoguchi, E., Chiu, Y.-L. et al.
abstract: Zoantharians (Cnidaria) are globally distributed from shallow reefs to the deep sea, yet their genomic resources remain scarce. Within the zoantharian genus Palythoa, most species harbor photosymbiotic dinoflagellates, whereas some have secondarily lost this symbiosis, allowing genomic changes associated with symbiotic status to be examined.
